text: arXiv Inspiration 是面向 DSH Web 的科研论文发现插件：它在 DSH 注册调研工具，并在设置页提供配置、调研结果浏览和反馈界面。用户可按 arXiv 类别与提交日期获取论文，结合本地研究兴趣和当前研究背景，经宿主 LLM 排序后查看推荐；也可管理论文知识库，并手动把选中的摘要推送到会话。插件还可选用 alphaXiv 补充语义发现和 PDF 问答。适合希望持续跟踪相关 arXiv 研究、整理论文并将结果用于当前会话的研究者。常规调研使用 DSH 已配置的 LLM；alphaXiv 增援需要本机已有 bundle 中的 Bearer token。

arXiv Inspiration helps DSH Web users find papers. Its tool fetches and ranks arXiv papers with the host LLM. A settings page supports review, feedback, library management, and manual session sharing. Optional alphaXiv adds discovery and PDF Q&A using a local bundle token.
想按自己的研究方向筛选最近的 arXiv 论文并收到推荐。
能不能把新论文调研结果整理好，再由我挑选后发进某个会话？
I want to keep a searchable library of arXiv papers and research notes.
arXiv Inspiration 的功能「按兴趣生成论文推荐」：通过调研工具选择类别、日期和研究背景，插件获取论文并用宿主 LLM 生成相关度排序与推荐结果，保存为可在设置页查看的记录。
arXiv Inspiration 的功能「管理论文知识库」：通过 DSH 知识库工具读取和维护研究兴趣、检索已收录论文及管理论文笔记；用户也能在设置页给推荐反馈，并手动选择会话接收论文摘要。
arXiv Inspiration 使用 alphaXiv 时，会把最多六个兴趣标签及研究背景或画像摘要发送到 api.alphaxiv.org；该功能可关闭，且需要从本机 alphaXiv bundle 读取 Bearer token。

dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · arXiv Inspiration：> [中文文档](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that turns
arXiv into a personalized research-inspiration feed: on-demand surveys filtered
by a local interest knowledge base + LLM ranking, a settings-page UI to review
and give feedback, an accumulating paper library, and full-text deep-read notes.

dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · Features：- **On-demand surveys** — pick weekdays (UTC+8) and arXiv categories, or run
  from a session with the `arxiv_inspiration` tool. Papers are fetched, coarse
  filtered by your KB, ranked in parallel LLM batches, and distilled into
  per-paper recommendations (中文推荐理由/💡启发/建议行动 + English agent context).
- **Settings-page UI** (arXiv Inspiration card): configure categories/weekdays/
  model/push preferences, launch surveys, review results with bilingual
  title/abstract, and give 👍/📖/👎 feedback — no auto-push, you decide what
  reaches a conversation.
- **Feedback loop** — 👍 auto-adds an interest chunk; 👎 gently down-ranks
  similar titles in later surveys (≤25% score penalty, single id exclusion).
  Feedback also feeds profile evolution.
- **Paper library** — every fetched paper accumulates in
  `~/.dsh-arxiv-inspiration/papers.jsonl` with scores, feedback, Chinese
  translations, notes, and deep-read state. Searchable (keyword + optional
  semantic), browsable in the UI, and queryable by agents via
  `arxiv_knowledge_base` tool actions (`search_papers`, `get_paper`,
  `add_paper`, …).
- **Deep-read notes** — recommended papers can be read full-t

dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · Requirements：- DSH host >=0.1.5-rc.1.
- An LLM provider configured in DSH (the plugin uses the host `llm` service
  and your session model selection by default; a specific provider/model can
  be pinned in settings).
- Node.js >= 22.
- Optional, for PDF full-text extraction and semantic search: Python (below).

All data is stored under `~/.dsh-arxiv-inspiration/`. Uninstalling the plugin
does not delete it.

dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · Python setup (optional, recommended)：PDF deep-read and semantic search use a small Python environment. Without it
the plugin still works — surveys, ranking, library, and notes run fine; PDF
deep-read is skipped and semantic search falls back to keyword matching.

The recommended way is [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):

```bash
dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · 1. Install uv (macOS / Linux)：curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh

dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · .venv inside its own install directory)：mkdir -p ~/.dsh-arxiv-inspiration
uv venv ~/.dsh-arxiv-inspiration/.venv

dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · 3. Install the two extras：uv pip install --python ~/.dsh-arxiv-inspiration/.venv/bin/python pymupdf fastembed
```

Notes:

dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · 3. Install the two extras：- `pymupdf` powers PDF text extraction (`scripts/pdf_parse.py`).
- `fastembed` powers semantic search (`scripts/kb_vec.py`, bge-small-en-v1.5,
  ONNX, no torch). The model downloads on first use to
  `~/.dsh-arxiv-inspiration/models/`.
- System Python 3.12 with PEP 668 (externally-managed environment) rejects
  direct `pip install` — that is why a venv via `uv` is recommended
  (`python3 -m venv` may lack `ensurepip` on macOS).
- The plugin resolves Python as: `.venv/bin/python` in its install directory
  first, then `.venv/bin/python` in `~/.dsh-arxiv-inspiration/`, then plain
  `python3` on PATH.

dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · alphaXiv credentials (optional)：The optional alphaXiv assist (semantic discovery + PDF Q&A with page
citations) talks to `https://api.alphaxiv.org/mcp/v1` with a Bearer token.
The plugin does **not** have a config field for it — it reuses the token from
a locally installed [alphaxiv MCP bundle](https://alphaxiv.org), so the
credential lives in exactly one place:

```
~/dsh-bundles/alphaxiv-mcp/cordis.patch.yml
```

dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · alphaXiv credentials (optional)：The plugin scans that file for a header line matching
`Authorization: Bearer <token>` and uses it as-is. If you already run the
alphaxiv MCP bundle, the file exists and nothing to do. Otherwise create it
manually with the same shape the bundle uses, e.g.:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: alphaxiv-mcp
      name: dsh-mcp-client
      config:

Notes:

dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · alphaXiv credentials (optional)：- Get a token from your alphaXiv account settings; calls to discovery/PDF
  Q&A consume your alphaXiv assistant quota.
- The token never leaves your machine; nothing is embedded in this plugin or
  its repo.
- No file / no token: both alphaXiv toggles degrade silently — surveys still
  run, deep-read falls back to local PyMuPDF extraction.
- Token cached for the host's lifetime; edit the file and restart the DSH
  host to pick up a new one.

dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · Configuration：Via the settings page (persisted to `~/.dsh-arxiv-inspiration/config.json`):
categories, weekdays, cross-list toggle, max papers per digest, LLM
provider/model, push count & prompt, research context, alphaXiv toggles.

Recall tuning (same page):

dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · Configuration：- **Hybrid recall** — when the filtered pool exceeds the candidate cap, a
  keyword lane and a local-embedding lane each rank the whole pool and are
  fused with reciprocal-rank fusion, instead of keeping only the newest N.
  Falls back to newest-first when the vector lane is unavailable (no local
  venv/model) or when the pool already fits the cap.
- **Candidate cap** — how many papers reach the LLM ranking (20-500).
- **Carry-over window / limit** — papers fetched by an earlier survey inside
  the window that were never recommended or pushed get a second chance.
  `0` days disables it.
- **Token budget / abstract chars** — ranking prompts are packed into batches
  by estimated token budget instead of a fixed paper count, with a
  configurable per-abstract truncation.

dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · Configuration：Every survey card also reports the recall funnel (`fetched + carry-over →
candidates → recommended`) and the cost line (keyword/semantic lane sizes,
LLM batch count, estimated tokens).

dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · arXiv Inspiration：> 中文文档 | [English](README.md)

一个 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：把 arXiv
变成个性化的科研灵感源——按本地兴趣知识库 + LLM 排序的按需调研、设置页内
查看与反馈的图形界面、持续累积的论文库，以及全文深读笔记。

dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · 功能：- **按需调研** — 选择星期（UTC+8）与 arXiv 类目发起调研，或在会话中用
  `arxiv_inspiration` 工具触发。抓取 → 知识库粗筛 → 并行 LLM 排序 → 逐篇
  推荐（中文推荐理由/💡启发/建议行动 + 英文 agent 上下文）。
- **设置页界面**（arXiv Inspiration 卡片）：配置类目/星期/模型/推送偏好、
  发起调研、双语标题摘要逐篇查看、👍/📖/👎 反馈——不自动推送，由你决定
  什么内容进入会话。
- **反馈闭环** — 👍 自动加入兴趣块；👎 在后续调研中温和降权（≤25% 分数
  惩罚 + 单 id 排除）。反馈同时驱动画像演化。
- **论文库** — 抓取过的论文持续累积在 `~/.dsh-arxiv-inspiration/papers.jsonl`，
  含评分、反馈、中文翻译、笔记与深读状态。支持关键词/语义检索，UI 可浏览，
  agent 可通过 `arxiv_knowledge_base` 工具操作（`search_papers`、`get_paper`、
  `add_paper` 等）。
- **深读笔记** — 推荐论文可全文精读（优先 alphaXiv PDF 问答，本地 PyMuPDF
  map-reduce 兜底）。完整笔记存于 `~/.dsh-arxiv-inspiration/analyses/<id>.md`，
  独立窗口查看；卡片只显示 3–5 条中文要点。agent 可读写笔记
  （`read_analysis` / `write_analysis`）并添加时间线笔记（`add_note` /
  `list_notes`）。
- **画像演化** — LLM 根据反馈历史起草修订版研究画像，你在界面上采纳/编辑/
  放弃；插件绝不静默改写你的画像。
- **alphaXiv 增援（可选）** — 跨类目语义发现与带页码引用的全文问答，复用
  你已有的 alphaxiv MCP 凭据；两个开关均可按调研关闭。
- **会话推送** — 把摘要（面向用户、双语）或论文列表+提示词（面向 agent）
  推送到任一会话。

dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · 环境要求：- DSH >=0.1.5-rc.1。
- DSH 中已配置 LLM provider（插件使用宿主 `llm` 服务，默认跟随会话模型
  选择；也可在设置页固定 provider/model）。
- Node.js >= 22。
- 可选（PDF 全文提取与语义检索）：Python，见下。

所有数据存于 `~/.dsh-arxiv-inspiration/`，卸载插件不会删除数据。

排序、论文库、笔记均可用；PDF 深读自动跳过，语义检索自动回退关键词匹配。

  `.venv/bin/python` → PATH 上的 `python3`。

dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · 配置：经设置页配置（持久化到 `~/.dsh-arxiv-inspiration/config.json`）：类目、
星期、cross-list 开关、每期推荐上限、LLM provider/model、推送数量与提示词、
研究背景、alphaXiv 开关。

召回调参（同一页面）：

- **混合召回**：过滤后池子超过候选上限时，关键词通道与本地向量通道各自对全池
  排一次序，再用 RRF 倒数排名融合取前 N，而不是只保留最新的 N 篇。向量通道
  不可用（本机缺 venv/模型）或池子本来就不超上限时，自动回到按时间直取。
- **候选上限**：进入 LLM 排序的篇数（20-500）。
- **回捞窗口 / 上限**：窗口内早前调研抓过、但既未推荐也未推送过的论文，给第二
  次机会。窗口为 `0` 天即关闭。
- **token 预算 / 摘要字符**：排序提示词按估算 token 预算自动装批，取代固定篇数
  批次；摘要截断长度独立可调。

dsh-arxiv-inspiration README · 配置：每张调研卡片还会显示召回漏斗（`抓取 + 回捞 → 候选 → 推荐`）与成本行（关键词/
语义两通道条数、LLM 批次数、估算 token 量）。
